Name: Ysabelle's Closet - Seasonal Outfits
Author: x3n3as
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZKBk7VPN/Ysabelle-Closet.png[/img]

I thought it was due time someone made some seasonal outfits for the many characters in the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url], and I thought why couldn't that be me? Oh right, because I really don't know how to code!

Based off [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]Zoedoll[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9559]Unofficial Ridgeside Village Seasonal Outfits - Alissa[/url].

This is in no way supposed to be treated like the official that will surely come in due time, I just wanted to share what I'd be using until then, I know I'm not alone when I say that changing clothes adds a lot to the NPCs and when you have Seasonal Outfits for the rest of the NPCs, those staying with the same clothes stick out like a sore thumb.

I'd like to take this opportunity to thank Zoedoll and the RSV team for allowing me to post it, considering the heavy lifting (the coding and original sprites + portraits) was done by them and I just poked around Photoshop a little to make new outfits. I think I learned a lot of pixel art doing this and I might continue the project if I have time!

Also, thanks to the lovely people at the[url=https://discord.com/invite/StardewValley] SDV Discord Server[/url] for the encouragement and the Spirit Day Idea - I honestly can't think of costumes for the life of me!

Anyway, without much further ado, here are the added outfits for Ysabelle:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3x0vw5Xw/Ysabelle-Outfits.png[/img]﻿
I hope I did Spirit Day justice! [s]It's supposed to be Black Swan

[/s]Anyway, thank you for downloading, reading thus far, and please please [b]please[/b], don't forget to endorse [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]Zoedoll[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]!
